ValidationRule.description: If the portal type is CRS, answer what support can priovde.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", ISPICKVAL(FW_Providing_Payor_Support__c, "Yes"), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT( FW_Authorized_to_Cancel_Plan__c )), ISBLANK(TEXT( FW_Authorized_to_Cancel_Installments__c )), ISBLANK(TEXT( FW_Authorized_to_Void_Installments__c )) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For CRS clients with Flywire support you must list if Authorized to Cancel Plan, Cancel Installment, Void Installments.
